title: Yoisaki Kanade — Wishing Her A Restful Night〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... They all should be...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry for asking you all to join me here on short notice. I know we're supposed to start working soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, that's totally fine!
We've all been looking forward to hearing the demo for the next song♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, Kanade, is Mafuyu not with you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
About that...
She isn't feeling all that well...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... She didn't seem to be running a fever, so I think she'll be fine...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But she did look really pale.
I told her to get some rest just in case.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Do you think she'll be able to sleep?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Good question...
It can be hard when you're feeling under the weather.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was with her until she lay down, and I went back to my own room after that to give her some privacy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm hoping that she'll be able to get some sleep...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would it be okay for me to go see her, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm worried about Mafuyu...
I'll be careful not to wake her if she's asleep.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If you're going, Miku, then I wanna go too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, if you two don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd feel a lot better knowing that you two are with her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, but not as many people will get to listen to your demo...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I asked Luka and Len to also join us, so they should be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, Miku, Rin, Mafuyu's in your hands!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Please let us know if anything happens.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess we can breathe a sigh of relief for now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I hope Mafuyu can get some rest...)
